row: OWR-14298580-008 (30005952) — Strong Heegaard Floer geography restriction

Alper Ferudun, A Negative Answer to the Strong Geography Question of Alfieri and Binns (30 September 2026), unrefereed AI-assisted computer-assisted preprint, version1.0; not Alec Kriebel authorship. The integral homology sphere Sigma(30,47,83), either orientation, has total ungraded F2[U] HF-minus torsion length16 and no length15 cyclic direct summand, answering the strong geography question negatively. This does not refute Lin's weaker restriction or the L-space conjecture.
